title: Correct upward acceleration
description: Essential: The student's final answer for part (1) must be 8 m/s².

title: Correct total time
description: Essential: The student's final answer for part (2) must be (1 + √2) s or approximately 2.414 s.

title: Force analysis for upward motion
description: Important: The student must correctly apply Newton's second law for the upward motion, identifying both gravity and kinetic friction acting down the incline.

title: Force analysis for downward motion
description: Important: The student must correctly apply Newton's second law for the downward motion, identifying that friction now opposes motion (up the incline).

title: Kinematics for ascent and descent
description: Important: The student must correctly use kinematic equations to find the ascent time/displacement and the descent time.

title: Sign error in friction direction
description: Pitfall: Penalize if the student uses the same frictional force direction for both upward and downward motion.

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional: The student's work should demonstrate consistent use of SI units (kg, m, s).

title: Trigonometric value substitution
description: Optional: The student correctly substitutes the given values for sin(37°) and cos(37°).
